optimizedDescription.value: GetConfig exposes a stable cloned construction-time SpecdConfig snapshot to hosts without disk I/O.

optimizedContext.value:
# GetConfig

## Rules
- Constructor accepts same `SpecdConfig` passed to `createKernel`; captures internal `structuredClone(config)`.
- Parameterless `GetConfig.execute()` returns `Readonly<SpecdConfig>` construction-time snapshot; same returned object identity across calls.
- No filesystem, `ConfigLoader`, or `ConfigWriter` calls; disk changes require kernel recreation.
- Host-facing read API only; domain use cases must not use it to re-inject full config into other execute inputs.
- Persist changes via `ConfigWriter` composition factories.
- Standalone `createGetConfig(config: SpecdConfig)` in `composition/use-cases/` returns `GetConfig` without full kernel.
- Config-based `createGetConfig(config, options?)` derives `GetConfigDeps` via `resolveGetConfigDeps(resolver)`, then delegates canonical `createGetConfig(deps)`.
- `resolveGetConfigDeps(resolver)` resolves `config: SpecdConfig`; sole use-case-specific config-bootstrap composition entry; no inline fs-shaped wiring.

## Constraints
- Never mutate snapshot after construction.
- Never expose live `SpecdConfig` used by internal kernel wiring (e.g. `ListWorkspaces`).
